scoring_justification: All target quantities (activation barriers, exothermicity, substituent TS difference) can be recomputed from the raw energies in computed_energies.json without trusting any self-reported metric.

steps.description: Recompute activation barriers, overall exothermicity, and substituent TS energy difference from the agent's raw energies and compare to paper gold within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for activation barriers, exothermicity, and substituent TS energy difference
hidden_assets.source_provenance: ACS Catal. 2021, 11, 6348–6356, Figure 3 and accompanying text (barriers 19.1, 17.4, 19.1 kcal mol⁻¹; exothermicity –9.1 kcal mol⁻¹; TS energies 13.6 and 9.5 kcal mol⁻¹, difference 4.1 kcal mol⁻¹).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper text; values are the exact numbers the paper reports for the B3PW91 enthalpy profile.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper’s own published results; the reviewer has verified them against the original publication.

outputs.description: Raw computed energies for all stationary points in both catalytic cycles; the hidden checker recomputes activation barriers, exothermicity, and substituent TS energy difference from these values. The `system` field must be one of the enumerated identifiers; each must appear for both `parent` and `pCF3` substrates.
